newsitem.title: USA: Carson Inc Q4 shr $0.12 before extra items.
newsitem.headline: Carson Inc Q4 shr $0.12 before extra items.

text.p: Carson Inc said late on Wednesday that proforma earnings for the fourth quarter were $1.8 million and earnings per share were $0.12, before previously announced extraordinary costs.

The company said the results include interest expense reductions. The extraordinary costs and the interest expense reductions are both from the initial public offering and related transactions on October 18, 1996, the company said.
It said net sales for the quarter ending December 31 were $21.2 million, a 33 percent increase over sales in the fourth quarter 1995.
The company could not be immediately reached for further information on fourth-quarter or full-year results.
